column3: The binding and not forgetting are expressed as completed.
You have done good to Your servant, rather than simply being good.
Their heart is singular and likened to fat.
Seeing and rejoicing are prospective without an explicit particle of wishing.
Fainting and hoping are expressed as completed.
The saying is grammatically linked to the eyes; no separate “I ask” occurs.
No explicit drying up is named.
The question asks the number of the servant’s days without explicitly naming waiting.
A relative clause says “which are not according to Your law.”
They pursued me with falsehood, rather than a passive statement of persecution without cause.
They nearly destroyed me on the earth, rather than explicitly removing me from it.
The earth’s standing is expressed as completed.
